prospects.thesis: SAIC offers compelling exposure to defense IT modernization and mission systems at a bargain 0.8x P/S, well below large-cap defense peers. With the FY27 defense budget emphasizing software-defined warfare and digital transformation of DoD infrastructure, SAIC's backlog visibility and services mix provide steady revenue conversion. Bullish options flow and institutional accumulation confirm smart money is positioning ahead of upcoming contract award cycles.

L3Harris sits at the intersection of tactical communications, space systems, and electronic warfare — the fastest-growing segments of the defense budget. The Aerojet Rocketdyne integration continues to drive margin expansion and munitions tailwinds remain intact amid replenishment demand. At 2.0x P/S with bullish options and institutional flow, LHX provides a different sub-niche (comms/EW) than SAIC's services exposure.

Microsoft remains the most durable large-cap AI play via Azure OpenAI monetization, Copilot attach rates across M365, and enterprise AI infrastructure buildout. The +6.4% 1M momentum reflects accelerating Azure growth and improving AI unit economics as custom silicon reduces NVIDIA dependency. Bullish options and institutional positioning ahead of the late-October earnings print signal conviction in capex-to-revenue conversion.

GitLab's Duo AI suite is driving ARR acceleration as enterprises consolidate DevSecOps spend and embed AI code generation into secure, self-hosted environments — a differentiated angle vs. GitHub Copilot. The +11.4% 1M move reflects re-rating on improving net retention and FedRAMP tailwinds. Bullish options and institutional accumulation at 8.8x P/S remain reasonable for a sub-$10B name with reaccelerating growth.

HII is the sole builder of U.S. nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and a key submarine prime, offering unique naval shipbuilding exposure amid Indo-Pacific tensions and AUKUS-driven Virginia-class acceleration. At 0.8x P/S with a -1.6% 1M dip, valuation is attractive relative to its multi-decade backlog visibility. Institutional bullishness suggests accumulation ahead of margin recovery as shipyard throughput and labor normalization materialize into 2027.
